description: Served as a Product Owner | Business Analyst for multiple enterprise platforms, including Selamnew Workspace, Service Desk (SD), and CRM systems. Led the product lifecycle end-to-end—driving backlog management, requirements definition, and cross-functional team delivery.
highlights: Managed the end-to-end product lifecycle for Selamnew Workspace, Service Desk (SD), and CRM platforms from requirements gathering to testing and release.
Owned and prioritized product backlogs, translating business requirements and stakeholder feedback into actionable development tasks.
Defined functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and feature specifications to guide engineering implementation.
Prepared Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), user guides, release notes, and system documentation.
Collaborated with developers, QA engineers, and stakeholders to align technical implementation, delivery timelines, and business priorities.
Designed system workflows, process flows, and UI/UX prototypes using AI prototyping to communicate requirements and improve usability.
